provenance.author: Vincent Russo
provenance.method: Galois descent over Z[i]: the four conjugates of the target under Gal(Q(zeta_16)/Q(i)) span a space of dimension min(4, m + 1); no search

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop, one core; about 10 s for the certificate

llm.role: found the descent argument and wrote the certificate

notes: Settles chi(|sqrtT>^3) = 4 with the four-term witness. Galois descent: the four conjugates (1, zeta^k)^3 of the target, k = 1, 5, 9, 13, restricted to one string of each Hamming weight 0 to 3 form a Vandermonde matrix in zeta, zeta^5, -zeta, -zeta^5, so they are independent and any stabilizer span containing the target has dimension at least 4; from m = 3 on the argument gives 4 for every m. Exact: computed as a rank over Q(zeta_16). Replaces the numerical pivot-search exclusion of the research survey (1,080 states, 185 pivots, closest approach 0.9981, too thin for the 0.01 margin of rank_exclusion.py).
